_evidence: The whole text-script / string pointer table [0x835846 + 4*id], ids 0..0xc3f (the highest id any R3 caller computes is 0xc11). The table is zero in the image - the game fills every entry when the text resources load, and readers (0x54d1ad, 0x54d798 script interpreter, 0x536920 message box copy, 0x4fd820) never null-test - so each entry points at its own 0x40-byte NUL-terminated string/script with the script_0054d798 byte set (no opcode 4, which dereferences the never-written [0x833f1c]). Compose instead of the per-id script_* layouts when a function reaches many ids. The 3136 entries share 48 distinct buffers (pool) so the table fits the input arena (one page-guarded buffer per entry would need 25 MB).
